digest.component_or_area: attestation validity and plan review pin enforcement
propositions: When enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, pin drift, malformed pins, or missing pinned targets must invalidate attestations and block claim consumption, reuse, and progressive refresh.

Configuration-optional enforce_plan_material_pins must fail-open on read error and emit structured warning plan_material_pin_config_unreadable without raising, preserving safe rollout for existing projects.

Derived DerivedPlanReviewHealth must aggregate target pin statuses by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and distinguish legacy-unpinned from absence, usable by all plan-review validity consumers.

Plan-review sidecar must persistently record reviewed_related_material as optional list of exact {role, canonical_id, material_fingerprint} items in plan_review_result_v2 format and parse them for re-sign enforcement without raising past consumer boundaries.

Re-sign recovery must validate reviewed_related_material against current state before signing, blocking on drift when enforcement is enabled and remaining advisory when disabled, without requiring a certified attestation.

Validity profiles DEFAULT, CLOSE, and DRIFT_REFRESH must control enforcement while DEFAULT and DRIFT_REFRESH each disable only code freshness; all profiles retain signature, registry, own-material, and pin checks, with DRIFT_REFRESH additionally delegating reopen and dependency-drift qualification.
